name: multi-ai-orchestrator-backend
description: Personal multi-AI collaboration workspace backend. Single-owner login (email/password from .env, multi-device sessions, logout-everywhere support), orchestrates multiple AI providers (Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Qwen/DashScope, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Grok) through a role-based agent pipeline (Creator -> Reviewer -> Critic -> Finalizer) and streams progress to the frontend in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
